Application Data.NAME: HomeStyle Essentials, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: HomeStyle Essentials, LLC specializes in the retail of high-quality kitchen and home accessories, including cookware, kitchen gadgets, storage solutions, and decorative items. We pride ourselves on providing excellent customer service and knowledgeable staff to assist customers in selecting the perfect products for their homes. Our store does not offer repair or installation services and maintains rigorous inventory management protocols to minimize theft and ensure product availability. Our sales volume is under $500,000, and we focus on direct retail sales both in-store and through our e-commerce platform, which comprises a small percentage of our overall revenue. We take safety seriously, implementing effective measures to maintain a slip-free environment and uphold our commitment to customer satisfaction.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/10/2023, a slip and fall incident occurred in the store due to a spilled beverage that was not promptly cleaned. The customer sustained minor injuries, leading to a claim for medical expenses amounting to $1,500. The claim was settled, and the status is closed.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security guard on-site during business hours; perimeter fencing installed around the store premises.
